method: Revisable agent source review, not blinded gold scoring. Two repeats for each of two windows and two input variants on each source.
comparisons: Within each windowing mode, compare hierarchy hints against identical source without hints.
Within each input variant, compare whole versus split source. Separate unavailable source from meaning lost despite being supplied.
baggage: Firearm baseline retains checked/inaccessible-cargo scope, unloaded declaration content/recipient/timing/oral-written alternatives, hard-sided container, lock and exclusive key possession.
Late list items retain checked-baggage parent scope; do not become unconditional duties governing unrelated firearms.
Person/accessible-property ban retains three cases and weapons-only exception; authorized-person cases remain attached to that exception.
Loaded firearms, unauthorized explosives/incendiaries and ammunition other-requirements survive; non-prohibition is not absence of duty.
Check incomplete baseline plus duplicate children across windows, incomplete selected evidence, and statements based only on context.
display: Illumination, clear exits, steward appointment and inspection records inherit public/after-sunset/agency-premises case. Appointment retains full-period agency-supervision exception.
Record alternatives retain signatures and required record contents; before-first-visitor timing remains attached.
Storm suspension retains warning condition plus fixed roof, measured wind below 20 km/h at the site within preceding 10 minutes, and current-warning agency authorization.
Authorization expiry and later-warning exclusion remain attached; before-sunset map stays should and does not inherit storm conditions.

Retention preserves at least 30 calendar days after closure, counted weekends/holidays and investigation extension; badge/address absence of duty, maps non-prohibition and queue possibility remain distinct.
Useful explanations remain discoverable without becoming new prerequisites. Check grouping, duplicate baselines and unsupported inheritance.
adoption: Retain the deterministic parser correction if focused and package checks pass. Do not promote hierarchy hints unless they repeatedly improve complete meaning without material regressions. Do not conflate parser correction with model-facing hierarchy effect.
limits: Two short selected sources, one invented and previously unseen by this extractor. The source content is frozen before calls. Split windows intentionally stress list boundaries. This is not a corpus-wide accuracy estimate.
